splash.hero: Your AI Agent programming assistant. Combining OpenCowork's toolchain, KodaClaw's memory and personality system, and OpenClaw's active recall mechanism.

features.localFirstDesc: Agents can work with files, terminals, projects, memory, and workspace context on your machine.
features.extensibleDesc: Create focused assistants, delegate tasks, and keep a human-in-the-loop workflow.
features.intelligentDesc: Choose a SOUL.md persona so every conversation starts from the right collaboration style.

personaSelect.hint: You can modify or create new personas in Settings anytime
